items.claim: He throws a lot of single shots and lacks head movement.
items.quote: does throw a lot of single shots and he doesn't really have a bunch of head movement

items.claim: He possesses fight-altering power that makes opponents wobble.
items.quote: he's got the power to make it an equal fight with most people. When he lands it it it makes you give do the like the baby deer legs

items.claim: He has decent grappling and very powerful ground and pound.
items.quote: decent grappling, not great but decent. He's got very powerful ground and pound

items.claim: Body lock takedowns are mostly available for him.
items.quote: body lock takedowns they're there for the most part.

items.claim: He is a solid striker with very fast kicks, good boxing combinations, and stays safe on the feet.
items.quote: He's a solid striker, he's got very fast kicks, good boxing combinations, stays safe on the feet, he doesn't do anything risky.

items.claim: He picks his shots well and has good counters, though he can be too patient.
items.quote: He picks his shots well, he's got good counters, he can be too patient though.
